faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar F-Type V6 use?
faqLeft.a: The F-Type V6 uses the AJ126 - a 3.0-litre supercharged V6. It was fitted from the F-Type's launch in 2012 through to 2024, across the single X152 generation. The V6 S uses the same base engine with a different state of tune.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar F-Type V6 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,600. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my F-Type V6?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ126 F-Type V6 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, tensioners and guides as standard on every AJ126 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used F-Type V6 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my F-Type V6 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an F-Type V6 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most F-Type V6 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
